episodes.title: A Vacation Recommendation
episodes.summary: In the blink of an eye, a famous young chancellor named Lizel finds himself transported to another world.

episodes.title: An Adventurer's Debut
episodes.summary: Lizel embarks on his first mission with Gil and ends up meeting a wide variety of people.

episodes.title: A Letter From Ray
episodes.summary: With help from Gil, Lizel easily completes jobs for the guild, which attracts attention from a collector.

episodes.title: Arriving in Marcade
episodes.summary: Judge cooks an extravagant meal on the road, while Lizel and Gil take turns keeping watch.

episodes.title: Equals
episodes.summary: Lizel and Gil win a valuable item at an auction.

episodes.title: Judge's Grandfather
episodes.summary: Lizel and Gil report their discovery at the labyrinth to the guild and have lunch with Judge's grandfather.

episodes.title: The Night of Promotion
episodes.summary: Lizel is promoted from adventurer rank F to E, so he goes out with Gil, Stud, and Judge to celebrate.

episodes.title: The Midday Attack
episodes.summary: Lizel volunteers to fill in for an injured performer in a play.

episodes.title: Judge's Problem
episodes.summary: Despite being terrified by Lizel the day before, Eleven returns to ask to join his adventuring party.

episodes.title: Eleven's Request
episodes.summary: Lizel and his companions investigate the theft of labyrinth goods by a merchant's guild staff member.

episodes.title: Welcome to the Party
episodes.summary: Before welcoming Eleven into his party, Lizel must deal with the remnants of the Forky Gang.
